name: indoor2
imu_ext_note: R_BC (9, row-major) + t (3): runs/stella_vio/imu/ext_indoor2_stella_fit.txt, rotation fitted from a visual trajectory + gyro of the SAME sequence (stella_vio/tools/ext_fit.py); the dataset-calibration variant is ext_indoor2_stella_cal.txt / ext_indoor2.txt
imu_toff_note: camera->IMU clock offset [s] from the same fit (ext_fit.py)
imu_bg_note: gyro bias from the first <=60 s visual fit (runs/stella_vio/imu/gyro_pred.md); only used by gyro=1
fixes_note: indoor fixes are unusable (sigma 20-67 m): the run is GNSS-free

gait.note: per-user constant fitted on the GT speed of the OTHER three Mobile-GVIO sequences (gnss_fusion/work/gait_cal.json, gf_gait_study.fit_c); this sequence is held out

imu_ext_cal_note: dataset-calibration extrinsic (runs/stella_vio/imu/ext_indoor2_stella_cal.txt), no fit to the sequence; used by the sensitivity variant fullcal
